group_definition: exact equality of all 42 parsed predictor values, no rounding and no targets
group_id_convention: zero-based first occurrence in each source file; bound to source SHA-256 and row order
row_policy: retain every original observation and label; no deduplication, conflict removal, or relabeling
calibration_policy: Within validation, fold 0 is calibration and the other fold is model_selection
split_selection_rule: prespecified fold 0; no seed search, no test input, no model performance used
final_model_training_policy: fit on train role only; do not refit on validation before the documented final test
scope: offline tabular benchmark; temporal and deployment causality unverified
